theorem aime_1984_p5 (a b : ℝ) (h₀ : 0 < a ∧ 0 < b) (h₁ : Real.logb 8 a + Real.logb 4 (b ^ 2) = 5)
    (h₂ : Real.logb 8 b + Real.logb 4 (a ^ 2) = 7) : a * b = answer(512) := by
  -- Strategy:
  -- - Use the identity log_b(x) = ln x / ln b.
  -- - Convert all logs to natural logarithms for easier manipulation.
  -- - Express equations h₁ and h₂ in terms of ln a and ln b.
  -- - Solve the resulting system of linear equations to find ln a and ln b.
  -- - Exponentiate to get a * b.

  let ln_a := Real.log a (Real.ofNat 10)
  let ln_b := Real.log b (Real.ofNat 10)

  have h₃ : Real.logb 8 a = (Real.log a (Real.ofNat 10)) / (Real.log 8 (Real.ofNat 10)) :=
    by rw [Real.logb, Real.log_div]

  have h₄ : Real.logb 4 (b ^ 2) = (Real.log (b ^ 2) (Real.ofNat 10)) / (Real.log 4 (Real.ofNat 10)) :=
    by rw [Real.logb, Real.log_div]

  let eq₁ := h₁.trans (by rw [h₃, h₄])

  have h₅ : Real.logb 8 b = (Real.log b (Real.ofNat 10)) / (Real.log 8 (Real.ofNat 10)) :=
    by rw [Real.logb, Real.log_div]

  have h₆ : Real.logb 4 (a ^ 2) = (Real.log (a ^ 2) (Real.ofNat 10)) / (Real.log 4 (Real.ofNat 10)) :=
    by rw [Real.logb, Real.log_div]

  let eq₂ := h₂.trans (by rw [h₅, h₆])

  -- Convert to natural logs
  let ln8 := Real.log 8 (Real.ofNat 10)
  let ln4 := Real.log 4 (Real.ofNat 10)

  have h₇ : eq₁ ↔ (ln_a / ln8 + (2 * ln_b) / ln4 = 5) :=
    by rw [eq₁, h₃, h₄]

  have h₈ : eq₂ ↔ (ln_b / ln8 + (2 * ln_a) / ln4 = 7) :=
    by rw [eq₂, h₅, h₆]

  -- Use nlinarith to solve the system of linear equations
  let h₉ := (by nlinarith! at h₇ h₈)

  have h₁₀ : ln_a / ln8 + (2 * ln_b) / ln4 = 5 :=
    by rw [h₇]

  have h₁₁ : ln_b / ln8 + (2 * ln_a) / ln4 = 7 :=
    by rw [h₈]

  -- Solve the system of linear equations
